subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

Don't you ever _________ your voice at me.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb** "raise"** is commonly used to indicate increasing the volume of one's voice.
 
• Other options like "put", "push", and "erupt" do not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"raise your voice."**
 
• Thus, the correct option is "raise".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Don't you ever** raise **your voice at me."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Put your voice" **does not make sense in this context.
 
• **"Push your voice" **is not a commonly used phrase.
 
• **"Erupt your voice" **is also not a valid phrase in English.
